gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager
notes: [tech] email→imiːl. Ḥassāniyya frame نَبْغِي 'I want' (tainecheikh2007). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عَنْدِي laptop جَدِيد بَسّ wifi بَطِيء
raw: عندي laptop جديد بس wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʕandiː labtub ʒaˈdiːd ˈbass wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I have a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); wifi→wifi — loan /f/ KEPT [f] (nativised loans are not subject to the native *f→[v] rule). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have to do an update for the program
notes: [tech] update→abdat. Ḥassāniyya نْدِير 'I do'. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imiːl. Genitive exponent مْتَاع (tainecheikh2007). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/→[dʒ]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I saw a nice video online
notes: [daily] CONTRAST: native شُفْت→ʃuvt (inherited *f→[v], Ḥassāniyya, tainecheikh2007 §2.1.1.3) vs loan video→fidiu (/v/→[f], loan f untouched by the rule); online→unlin. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: فِي offer بْنِين وْ discount كْبِير يَاسِر
raw: في offer بنين و discount كبير ياسر
ipa: ˈviː ufar ˈbniːn w disawnt ˈkbiːr ˈjaːsir
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a very big discount
notes: [commerce] native فِي→viː (*f→[v]); offer→ufar; discount→disawnt. Intensifier يَاسِر 'very' (Ḥassāniyya/Bedouin). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: delivery يُوصَل غُدْوَة وْ الدَّفْع cash
raw: delivery يوصل غدوة و الدفع cash
ipa: dilifari ˈjuːsˤɑl ˈʁudwa w adˈdavʕ kaʃ
gloss_en: delivery arrives tomorrow and payment is cash
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari; cash→kaʃ; native الدَّفْع→ddavʕ (*f→[v]). غُدْوَة 'tomorrow' (tainecheikh2007). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: الْكَرْهَبَة مْتَاعِي فِيهَا مُشْكِل فِي engine
raw: الكرهبة متاعي فيها مشكل في engine
ipa: alˈkarhaba ˈmtaːʕiː ˈviːhaː ˈmuʃkil ˈviː inɡin
gloss_en: my car has a problem in the engine
notes: [automotive] engine→inɡin (/ɡ/ in inventory); native فِيهَا/فِي→viːhaː/viː (*f→[v]). كَرْهَبَة 'car'. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: this model is new and automatic
notes: [automotive] model→mudil; automatic→aatumatik. Demonstrative هَاذَا (interdental retained, tainecheikh2007 §2.1.1.2). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَنَا think هَاذَا model غَالِي يَاسِر
raw: أنا think هاذا model غالي ياسر
ipa: ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaːðaː mudil ˈʁaːliː ˈjaːsir
gloss_en: I think this model is very expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (/θ/ RETAINED — matches Ḥassāniyya interdental retention, tainecheikh2007 §2.1.1.2); model→mudil. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نْشُوفَك فِي weekend إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك في weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːvak ˈviː wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind; native نْشُوفَك→nʃuːvak (*f→[v], tainecheikh2007) + فِي→viː. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: call me on the telephone tonight
notes: [tech] French loan تِلِيفُون 'telephone' < Fr. téléphone; attested Ḥassāniyya keeps [f]: [ttilifuːn] (tainecheikh2007, French stratum). PIPELINE WRONG: emits ttiliˈːvuːn — applies the native *f→[v] rule to a French loan (which must keep [f]) and misplaces stress inside the length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: French-contact loan into ar-MR (Taine-Cheikh 2007 on the French borrowing stratum)

gloss_en: he brought me the bill
notes: [commerce] French loan فَاكْتُور 'bill' < Fr. facture; attested keeps [f]: [lfaːktuːr]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits lvaˈːktuːr — *f→[v] wrongly applied to the French loan (should keep [f]) + stress inside length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: French-contact loan into ar-MR (Taine-Cheikh 2007 on the French borrowing stratum)

gloss_en: the driver came
notes: [automotive] French loan شُوفُور 'driver' < Fr. chauffeur; attested keeps [f]: [ʃʃuːfuːr]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits aʃʃuˈːvuːr — *f→[v] on the French loan (should keep [f]) + stress inside length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: French-contact loan into ar-MR (Taine-Cheikh 2007 on the French borrowing stratum)

gloss_en: give me the fork, boy
notes: [daily] French loan فُرْشِيطَة 'fork' < Fr. fourchette; attested keeps [f]: [lfurʃiːtˤɑ]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits lvuˈrʃiːtˤɑ — *f→[v] wrongly applied to the French loan (should keep [f]). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: French-contact loan into ar-MR (Taine-Cheikh 2007 on the French borrowing stratum)

gloss_en: the bread with jam is tasty
notes: [daily] French loan كُنْفِتِير 'jam' < Fr. confiture; attested keeps [f]: [lkunfitiːr]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits bilkunviˈtiːr — *f→[v] on the French loan (should keep [f]). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. بْنِين 'tasty' (tainecheikh2007). table: French-contact loan into ar-MR (Taine-Cheikh 2007 on the French borrowing stratum)

gloss_en: how are you today? are you well?
notes: [daily] Arabizi (7abibi): 7=ح. Spells اِشْحَالَك الْيُوم اِنْتَ لَبَاس (Ḥassāniyya greeting išḥālak/labās, tainecheikh2007 ch.10). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa = the Ḥassāniyya reading (Taine-Cheikh (2007) L'arabe des Bīδān (Ḥassāniyya); Heath (2004) Hassaniya Arabic)

gloss_en: I don't want coffee, I want tea
notes: [daily] Arabizi: gh=غ, g=qāf→[ɡ] (tainecheikh2007 §2.1.1.2), ch=/ʃ/ negation -š. Spells مَا نَبْغِيش قَهْوَة نَبْغِي أَتَاي. unsupported; ipa = the Ḥassāniyya reading (atāy 'tea', Taine-Cheikh (2007) L'arabe des Bīδān (Ḥassāniyya); Heath (2004) Hassaniya Arabic)

gloss_en: how much is this? two hundred ouguiya
notes: [commerce] Arabizi: 7=ح, th=ث (retained /θ/). Spells شْحَال ثَمَن هَاذَا مِيتَين أُوقِيَّة (ūgiyya Mauritanian currency, heath2004hass). unsupported; ipa = the Ḥassāniyya reading (Taine-Cheikh (2007) L'arabe des Bīδān (Ḥassāniyya); Heath (2004) Hassaniya Arabic)
